description: Browse the Alza category tree one level at a time. Useful for narrowing a product search — find the right category id, then pass it to `search_products` as `category_id`. Without arguments, returns top-level categories.

parent_id.description: Parent category id. Omit to list top-level categories. Pass an id from a previous result to drill down.

name: list_categories
title: List Alza categories
